caption:
You make the bed but it never looks hotel-crisp.

Regular pillowcases often have a loose or zippered end, so pillows shift inside and poke out around the edges. That little gap is enough to make an otherwise made bed look unfinished.

This set uses an envelope closure that folds over and tucks the pillow in fully instead of a loose or zippered opening. That keeps all four pillows looking the same across the top of the bed.

For about $12 you get a matching set of four, so the whole pillow row looks pulled together instead of mismatched.
